Scopes Actions

Scopes actions at a glance

Step Purpose
Channel Display Enable or disable a channel display
Channel Scale / Offset Set vertical scale (V/div) and offset (V)
Horizontal Scale / Position Set horizontal scale (s/div) and position (s)
Edge Trigger Set trigger source, slope and level
Single Wait Start one acquisition and wait for triggering
Measure Read a numeric measurement
Capture Save waveform CSV and metadata JSON
Screenshot Save an instrument image
AutoScale Automatically adjust display; specified Keysight models only

Add a Scopes instance in Setup, then select the target in each step. Parameters and limits follow.

Setpoint sources

The Scopes group offers Channel Display, Channel Scale, Channel Offset, Horizontal Scale, Horizontal Position, Edge Trigger, Measure, Capture, Screenshot, and AutoScale. Channel Scale, Channel Offset, Horizontal Scale, Horizontal Position, and Edge Trigger Level allow only numeric Fixed value, Variable, or Calculation setpoints. Calculation operands are fixed numbers or variables, with Add, Subtract, Multiply, or Divide. Templates enforce these restrictions; general Output, Set Variable, Assert, and While sources remain available. Each of these five Scopes setpoints is required, supplied by a fixed value or binding. Measure exposes Value, Unit, Channel, and Item for Output or Assert.

Readback after setting

Channel Display, Channel Scale, Channel Offset, Horizontal Scale, Horizontal Position, and Edge Trigger read back the setting after applying it. If the readback fails, is missing, or differs beyond the allowed tolerance, the Step reports FAIL. For a mismatch, the error shows the requested and returned values and any numeric tolerance that applies. When verification succeeds, Result comes from the Set command. Set and Query each use the existing timeout.

TDS2024B and TBS1052B accept an absolute difference up to ±0.05 V for Edge Trigger Level, including settings close to zero. For example, a 1.00 V setting passes with a 1.04 V readback and fails with a 1.06 V readback. Source Channel and Slope must still match exactly.

Scope Measure: validity

Foreground Measure also offers Valid (/valid) for IF/ELSE. A measurement with a usable value returns true. A confirmed invalid measurement sentinel with clean instrument status completes as a successful Step with /valid = false and /value = null. In IF/ELSE choose Previous step result → Valid and compare it with Boolean false. All other invalid responses, instrument or Worker errors, and cancellation still fail the Step. Invalid data does not prove that no waveform exists; Orchestrator does not retry automatically.

Model-specific choices

Measurement Item, trigger Slope, and Capture Points are fixed dropdowns from the current Scopes capabilities. Measurement items and slopes save canonical strings; Measurement Item capitalizes the first English letter for display, with vpp shown as Vp-p while still saving vpp. Points saves a number and cannot use a binding. Simulation uses the default model; Live uses the target's canonical model ID. Changing mode, model, target instance, or executable reloads the options. Loading, unavailable capabilities, or empty lists disable selection. An invalid or unconfirmed value requires explicit reselection; options never change saved values automatically. Scopes validates final model support. A queued job counts as complete only after Scopes reports its terminal result.

Scope Single Wait

Scope Single Wait starts a single acquisition and waits finitely for its trigger. Trigger Timeout (ms) defaults to 5000 and Poll Interval (ms) to 100; both are fixed positive integers, and Poll Interval cannot exceed Trigger Timeout. There is no Force Trigger option. A confirmed trigger timeout is a successful Step with /outcome = timeout and /timed_out = true; use those fields in the existing IF/ELSE. Instrument, Worker, and cancellation errors still fail the Step. A timed-out trigger does not mean capture succeeded, and Orchestrator does not automatically force, stop, or reset the instrument.

The Single Wait Result selector shows comparison types and values: Outcome is String (natural means trigger completed; timeout means trigger wait expired); Timed Out and Capture Allowed are Boolean (true or false). Choose the matching type on the other side of IF/ELSE; selecting a result does not change the other operand.

Select channels

Channel Display, Channel Scale, Channel Offset, and Measure use a fixed Channel dropdown; Edge Trigger uses Source Channel. Options are CH1, CH2, etc., from offline Scopes capabilities. Simulation uses simulator channels; Live uses the target instance's identified model. Changing mode, target instance, Live model, or Scopes executable refreshes the options. Loading, missing Live model, query failure, or no supported channels prevents new fixed selections and shows a hint. Saved unsupported values stay visible and are preserved when saving and reloading. Existing Channel bindings are preserved with a hint; only explicitly choosing a supported fixed channel replaces the value and removes its binding. Other bindings remain unchanged.

Scope Capture: channels

Capture Channels uses capability-based CH1, CH2, etc., checkboxes. Choose one or more channels; the last selected channel cannot be unchecked. Saved unsupported channels or invalid values are preserved with a hint and shown with no boxes checked. Checking a supported channel replaces them with a valid selection. Existing Channel bindings are likewise preserved until fixed channels are explicitly selected. Loading capabilities or changing models never rewrites saved channels automatically.

Scope AutoScale

Scope AutoScale is a Keysight-only Foreground Step (DSOX2004A, DSOX3024A, DSOX4024A, DSOX4034A). Source Channels, Acquire Mode (Normal/Current), and Channels Mode (All/Displayed) are optional; omitted choices are not sent to Scopes Tool. Unchecking every Source Channel omits that option. AutoScale may change channel display/scale, horizontal scale, trigger, and other instrument state; Orchestrator does not restore those settings automatically. For Background Measure Streaming, finish the required Scopes Setup before Worker ON; AutoScale cannot run on an active streaming Worker. A Step succeeds only when its Async Job completes, and Scopes Tool may report a fallback to bare AutoScale if a selected-source command is rejected. Simulation does not verify physical waveform scaling.

Scope Screenshot: format

Screenshot Image Format uses offline Scopes capabilities: Simulation uses the default model, and Live uses the saved device model. Unsupported formats remain visible but disabled. A saved unsupported format is preserved with a warning when the model changes. If capabilities are unavailable, the editor shows the reason and disables new format selections.

Scopes File Output

Scopes File Output in the left Workflow panel requires at least one Scopes Tool Instance in the current Template. Without one, its header is greyed out, shows a lock and No Scopes Tool Instance. Add one in Setup., and cannot be expanded; its settings are hidden. Adding the first Scopes instance unlocks it; removing the last locks it again. Loading a Template updates this lock from its instances. Simulation and Live use the same rule, without requiring a saved Live Resource. Locking or unlocking preserves the chosen folder and expand/collapse state, independently of the Scopes step category.

When unlocked, expand Scopes File Output. Select Folder chooses a folder shared by Capture and Screenshot; Use Default restores Orchestrator application folder / data. The choice is local runtime state and is never saved in a Template. Capture produces CSV and metadata JSON; Screenshot produces an image in the selected format. Every execution, including loop iterations and later runs, receives new absolute file paths. Existing files are not overwritten. Job failure or missing required files fails the step. This panel is separate from CSV Export of Workflow Output rows.
